prompt: Phase 09 Prompt 28 — Unsupported Claim Checks + Review Routing
objective: Implement unsupported claim detection and review routing — each retrieved item is a claim; unsupported claims (lacking source support) are detected and routed to human review, never presented as fact. Advisory only; no claim/entitlement determination.

summary.migrator_change: None — reuses the existing V38 second_brain_retrieval_unsupported_claim_checks table. Schema stays 38, contract table count stays 190.
summary.reuse: Structural support rule from synthesis/semantic_output_evaluation (Prompt 23); the deterministic RetrievalBroker corpus; the review-tier->status mapping (synthesis/reasoning); EXCLUDED_FAMILIES (retrieval/policy).

design.detection: A claim (RetrievalItem) is supported iff it has a source_ref + an allowlisted non-excluded source_family; else unsupported.
design.review_routing: unsupported -> review_required (tier 3), reason unsupported_no_source_link / unsupported_excluded_family; supported-but-tier3/stale/conflict -> routed at its tier status (review_required tier 3, review_recommended tier 2), reason supported_review_flagged; clean supported -> not routed. Canonical mapping: 1->auto_advisory, 2->review_recommended, 3->review_required.
design.status: clean / review_routed / blocked (blocked iff any unsupported claim — zero tolerance: an unsupported claim must not be presented as fact).
design.doctrine: Advisory only — assembles_final_answer=false, claim_determination_made=false; makes NO claim or entitlement determination (claim_or_entitlement_decision_performed + unsupported_claim_performed guards stay 0). Metadata-only: hashed per-claim routing records (source_ref_hash, source_family, review_tier, review_status, reason) — no raw claim text/excerpt/source ref.
design.read_only: emit_receipt defaults False (no operator-DB write); receipt persistence (one guard-clean row to the V38 unsupported_claim_checks table) exercised in the proof on a temp DB.

operator_db_outcome.rationale: On the real operator corpus all 408 retrieved claims are source-supported (status=clean, no unsupported claims) — an honest demonstration that the deterministic corpus is well source-linked. emit_receipt defaulted False -> nothing persisted.
